title: Canonical comparison for a prescribed injective resolution
statement: Let A and B be abelian categories with bounded below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], with enough injectives in A. Let F:A\to B be additive [def-sp-left-exact-additive] and I an injective resolution of X [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Define canonicalResolutionDerivedIso F I from RF(X[0]) to Q of the zero extension of F(I) by applying RF to the augmentation isomorphism, composing with the inverse F derived unit on the extended injective complex, then applying Q to the map/extension isomorphism. The auxiliary resolutionAugmentationIso and resolutionDerivedIso implement its first two factors.

lean.statement:
def canonicalResolutionDerivedIso
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [EnoughInjectives A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B]
    [HasDerivedCategory A] [HasDerivedCategory B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] {X : A} (I : InjectiveResolution X) :
    F.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.obj ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor A 0).obj X) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Plus.Q.obj
        ⟨((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).extend
          ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat, 0, inferInstance⟩
